column1: # Rows for show-rule-at-action.sh. Columns, tab-separated: id, tools, field, pattern, exclude, mode, scope.
# See the header of the script. The doc for an id is docs/on-demand/<id>.md. `-` means no exclude;
# scope is optional (`main` = not inside a sub-agent).
# deny-once is for an action that cannot be taken back (a window that takes focus, a request to a
# third party, a message sent to another session); every other row is note-once.
